title: Bits of a folded binary word
statement: For every finite bit string $xs$, fold its bits from right to left using $b,n\mapsto 2n+b$, starting from $1$. The binary expansion of the resulting natural number, written from least significant bit to most significant bit, is $xs$ followed by a final bit $1$.
